frame-arabic.note: No Arabic in any frame of either size (see frame-audit.txt).

frame-hidden.note: No recordings: every frame is drawn by the kit. No notification, email, phone number or contact suggestion appears.

frame-google.note: Google appears only as plain words ("Publish it on Google?", "goes to Google", "is on Google"); no Google logo or colours, nothing suggesting approval.

frame-proof.note: The review quote belongs to the Example business and is shown as a message to approve, not as proof. No stars, star icons, ratings, counts, logos or testimonial framing in any frame.

frame-people.note: No people or faces in any frame; the Kabsi mark is the only picture.

frame-example.note: The Example badge sits in the chat header and is on screen in every frame from 0.0 to 12.0 s in both sizes, including the empty opening and closing frames.

frame-yes.note: Yes, Edit, Skip show from 1.5 s, the Yes is tapped at 4.5 s and the owner's Yes bubble follows at 4.8 s, before Approved.

safe-zone.note: 1080 x 1920: all text is inside the safe area (the header text starts below y 280, the lowest text ends above y 1440, the right-most text ends near x 915). 1080 x 608: the plan sets no safe zone for it. The phone is cropped top and bottom, so the header sits about 8 px from the top and the chat runs off the bottom; the kit's own 60 px margin for other sizes is not kept there. Lane R to decide if that matters on the website.

tap-rings.note: One soft dark ring on the Yes button at 4.5 s, half a second, in both sizes.

end-card.note: No end card: this is a loop.

hook.note: The Kabsi chat is on screen from the first frame and the review slides in at 1.5 s, inside the first 2 seconds. Checked at 390 px wide on the 1080 x 608 file: the text is about 12.6 px, readable, and nothing is cut off except older messages that scroll out under the header after the Yes.

sound-off.note: No sound; the chat tells the whole story.
